question: Who among the following was revered as the 'Queen of Thumri'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Girija Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Girija Devi **is often revered as the** 'Queen of Thumri.' Girija Devi (1929 – 2017) **was an eminent Indian classical singer who performed classical and light classical music and popularized the genre of Thumri.
 
• She earned wide acclaim and numerous accolades for her soulful performances and rich contribution to Indian music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naina Devi:** 

 
 
• Naina Devi (1917–1993), born as Nilina Sen, was a renowned Indian vocalist of Hindustani classical music.
 
• She was a disciple of the famous classical singer Ustad Mushtaq Hussain Khan of the Rampur-Sahaswan gharana.
 
 
 
• **Siddheshwari Devi:**
 
 
• Siddheshwari Devi (1908–1976) was one of the most prominent Indian singers of the traditional genre of Hindustani classical music known as thumri.
 
• Known for her mastery over the emotive and romantic aspects of thumri, she made a significant impact on the Indian classical music scene.
 
 
 
• **Annapurna Devi:**
 
 
• Annapurna Devi (1927–2018) was an Indian surbahar (bass sitar) player of Hindustani classical music.
 
• She was one of the most notable disciples of Allauddin Khan, and she was the first wife of Ravi Shankar, the internationally renowned sitar virtuoso.
